widgets_values: 支持最多‌3 段视频‌（每段 2-15 秒，总时长不超过 15 秒），用于定义运镜风格或动作逻辑。
支持最多‌3 段音频‌（需与图像或视频搭配，总时长不超 15 秒），用于设置节奏、对白或环境声。

如果只要单采那就不要开启二阶段采样，分辨率选择器里选择你要的分辨率大小，推荐0.9，直出720p视频。
如果要开二阶段采样，那一阶段的分辨率就要调小，推荐0.4，先用低分辨率快速跑完一采，然后再用较低的步数再二次采样，此时二次采样就可以将分辨率拉高，根据自己的配置和需求来调（太高了也会影响速度）

PS：本地跑的话，可以先不开二采，先用一采来快速抽卡，抽到满意的，把种子锁定然后开二采来强化。
参考图像最多只能接入9张图像，如果不接入就关掉下面的开关

detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic xianxia fantasy style with bright blue skies, soft volumetric clouds, and glowing crystal-pagoda palaces floating in the distance.
[Shot 1] The scene opens on <Subject 1> (S1), the young cultivator with long black hair and pale-blue and white robes, seated calmly on <Subject 2>, the giant white crane with black-tipped wings and a red crown, gliding above a sea of clouds. Floating crystal palaces drift in the background as <Subject 1>'s robes and hair flutter in the high-altitude wind. The camera holds a static wide shot for a brief moment. At 00:02.000, <Subject 3>, the elderly cultivator with long white hair and beard and light-blue robes, crouches low on <Subject 4>, the ornate flying sword, and streaks into frame from the right at extremely high speed. A bright blue energy trail streams behind the sword as <Subject 3> flashes past <Subject 1> from right to left. The sudden gust violently blows <Subject 1>'s hair and sleeves backward. <Subject 1> (S1) turns his head sharply toward the departing figure, narrows his eyes with irritation, and shouts in the young male Mandarin voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 赶着去投胎啊老东西。</d> His lips press into a line as he watches <Subject 3> disappear into the distance, leaving a fading blue light trail across the clouds.
